# ColdIQ Marketplace API — raw endpoint catalog (pasted from api.coldiq.com/admin)
# PROVENANCE FILE — DO NOT EDIT. Normalized into ../catalog.json.
# Source: pasted by user 2026-06-08. Known issues: garbled "Cost" column values,
# a few truncated paths (e.g. "compach", "datas/page-intersection", "Pupapi").

POST /v1/ai-ark/companies — Company Search API — Search 70M+ enriched company profiles using flexible filters: industry, location, employee size, revenue, funding… — per result
POST /v1/ai-ark/people — People Search API — Search 500M+ enriched people profiles using contact and company filters: name, title, seniority, skills, education… — per result
POST /v1/ai-ark/people/reverse-lookup — Reverse People Lookup API — Look up a person profile by email address or phone number. Returns the full profile if found. Costs 5 credits. — flat
POST /v1/ai-ark/people/mobile-phone-finder — Mobile Phone Finder API — Find a person's mobile phone number by LinkedIn URL or name + company domain. Costs 10 credits per call. — free
POST /v1/ai-ark/people/export/single — Export Single Person with Email — Export a single person's full profile with verified email. Provide either the AI Ark person ID or a LinkedIn URL. — free
POST /v1/ai-ark/people/export — Export People with Email — Export up to 10,000 people profiles with vemails based on company and contact filters. Returns a trackId. — per result
POST /v1/ai-ark/people/email-finder — Find Emails by Track ID — Find emails for all people in a previous People Search result, identified by its trackId. — per result
GET /v1/ai-ark/people/export/{trackId} — Get Export People Results — Retrieve the result of an Export People job. — (poll)
GET /v1/ai-ark/people/email-finder/{trackId} — Get Email Finder Results — Retrieve the result of a Find Emails job. — (poll)

POST /v1/apollo/people/bulk-match — Bulk People Enrichment — Enrich up to 10 people in a single request. Costs 1 credit per person. — per result

POST /v1/apollo/people/search — People API Search — Search for people in Apollo's global database with filters like title, seniority, location, company. Costs 1 cr. — Cost 2,832 (garbled)
POST /v1/apollo/organizations/search — Organization Search — Search for organizations in Apollo's global database. Costs 1 credit. — Cost 2,832 (garbled)
POST /v1/apollo/organizations/info — Get Complete Organization Info — Get detailed information about a specific organization by its Apollo ID. Costs 1 credit. — Cost 2,832 (garbled)

POST /v1/blitzapi/search/waterfall-icp-keyword — Waterfall ICP Search — Search for people matching an ICP at a company using a cascading waterfall of title/location. — Cost 2,994 (garbled)
POST /v1/blitzapi/search/employee-finder — Employee Finder — Browse all employees at a company with optional filters for location, job level, job function, connections. — Cost 2,994 (garbled)

POST /v1/blitzapi/enrichment/company — Company Enrichment — Enrich a company profile from a LinkedIn URL. — Cost 2,994 (garbled)
POST /v1/blitzapi/enrichment/domain-to-linkedin — Domain to LinkedIn URL — Convert a website domain to the corresponding LinkedIn company URL. — Cost 2,994 (garbled)
POST /v1/blitzapi/enrichment/linkedin-to-domain — LinkedIn URL to Domain — Resolve a company's email domain from its LinkedIn profile URL. — Cost 2,994 (garbled)

GET /v1/career-site-jobs/search — List Career Site Job Listing API jobs — Returns your most recent career site job search jobs (newest first). — (list)
POST /v1/career-site-jobs/search — Career Site Job Listing API — Start an async job to search real job postings scraped from 175k+ company career sites across 54 ATS. — (async)
GET /v1/career-site-jobs/search/{jobId} — Get Career Site Job Listing API result — Poll the status. 202 while in progress, 200 with results. — free (poll)
